    MOD = 998244353

    # X array keeps track of the sum of (-S_l)^p for p in 0..K over all seen l

    S_pow = [0] * (K + 1)

            S_pow[j] = curr

            neg_S_pow = (neg_S_pow * neg_S) % MOD
            
    print(ans)
